target: Local full-history working tree on macOS 27.2 arm64

scenarios.id: MAG-006-A/B and complete native regression suites

scenarios.target: Direct stdio to the sandboxed Magpie Connection QA app via verify-codex --bridge
scenarios.observed: The switch started off and reached Ready when enabled. A fresh Codex session ran both tools and returned the exact proof for entry 73. The same search was rejected by the production bridge after the switch was turned off.

scenarios.client: Magpie --mcp-stdio with the executable synthetic client fixture and no cloud account
scenarios.observed: For both fixture identities, search and fetch worked before deletion. Search returned no matches and fetch denied the old ID after deletion.

An isolated stdio entry loaded via Reload MCP Configuration. The regular desktop chat used search_clips and get_clip and displayed the matching proof for entry 73. After disabling history access, a fresh chat received Magpie’s access-disabled error from the same server.

scenarios.client: ChatGPT in Google Chrome 157.0.8103.79 with OpenAI tunnel-client 0.0.21
scenarios.observed: Reused the dedicated private QA plugin and tunnel with the 73-entry sandboxed fixture. ChatGPT returned the matching proof, which appears only in the full clip. A fresh chat called the connector after access was turned off and displayed isError true with Magpie’s access-disabled message.
